preconditions.description: The number of queries q is within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each query's array length n is within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a_i) <= n for a_i in a.split() if a.split())
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array satisfies 1 ≤ a_i ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: sum(int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()) <= 3 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of all array lengths across queries does not exceed 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: For each query, the output is the count of stack exterminable subarrays in the given array a.
The count returned for each query is an integer.
